avoid_supplements.name: High-dose chromium
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Chromium enhances insulin sensitivity and glucose uptake, potentially potentiating hypoglycemic effect
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid supplementation or monitor blood glucose closely if used; coordinate with prescriber

avoid_supplements.name: Fenugreek seeds
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Fenugreek reduces blood glucose levels and may enhance insulin action, increasing hypoglycemia risk
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; educate patient on hypoglycemia warning signs

avoid_supplements.name: Ginseng (American and Asian)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Ginseng reduces fasting and postprandial glucose, potentiating insulin effect
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid or use only under close glucose monitoring; coordinate dosing with prescriber

caution_supplements.name: Alpha-lipoic acid
caution_supplements.mechanism: May modestly improve insulin sensitivity and glucose metabolism
caution_supplements.action: Monitor blood glucose; inform prescriber of use for dose optimization

caution_supplements.name: Cinnamon
caution_supplements.mechanism: Some evidence suggests mild glucose-lowering effects
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for hypoglycemia symptoms; coordinate with healthcare provider

avoid_foods.name: High glycemic index refined carbohydrates (white bread, sugary drinks, pastries)
avoid_foods.mechanism: Rapid glucose absorption causes unpredictable blood glucose spikes that are difficult to match with insulin dosing
avoid_foods.action: Educate on carbohydrate counting and encourage low-to-moderate glycemic index foods for glycemic stability

avoid_foods.name: Simple sugars and candy
avoid_foods.mechanism: Cause rapid postprandial hyperglycemia requiring insulin dose adjustment; increase hypoglycemia risk if insulin dose is fixed
avoid_foods.action: Restrict intake; use only for hypoglycemia treatment; coordinate carbohydrate intake with insulin timing

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: Fat delays gastric emptying and glucose absorption, potentially prolonging postprandial glucose elevation
caution_foods.action: Coordinate timing of insulin administration with meal composition; monitor glucose response

caution_foods.name: Alcohol (especially on empty stomach)
caution_foods.mechanism: Alcohol impairs hepatic gluconeogenesis and hypoglycemia awareness, increasing hypoglycemia risk
caution_foods.action: Limit intake; avoid on empty stomach; advise patient to monitor glucose and wear medical alert identification

monitoring_notes: Regular insulin requires precise timing with meals and carbohydrate counting; patient education on consistent meal composition and timing is critical for glycemic control. Monitor for hypoglycemia, particularly when supplements or dietary changes affect glucose absorption or insulin sensitivity.
